hero.heading: Turn Your Credibility Into Brand Equity
hero.description: Access funded campaigns with guaranteed payment. Work with emerging brands while transferring your trust and conviction to help them build market presence.

valueTransfer.title: The Value Transfer Mechanism
valueTransfer.subtitle: Your credibility becomes their brand equity

steps.title: Your Brand Equity
steps.description: You've spent years building your personal brand through your content platforms. Your audiences trust you, listen to you, and value your opinions. This trust is your brand equity.

steps.title: Credibility Transfer
steps.description: When you collaborate with a founder's brand, you're not just creating content. You're transferring some of your credibility to them. Your conviction becomes part of their brand story.

steps.title: Brand Equity Growth
steps.description: Money flowing to you translates directly into brand equity growth for the founder. It's not just about creating content - it's about transferring trust and audience conviction.

benefits.title: Benefits for Content Creators
benefits.subtitle: A stable revenue stream with guaranteed payment

items.title: Guaranteed Payment
items.description: Direct payment from investment pool ensures you get paid for your work, regardless of business outcome.

items.title: Stable Revenue Stream
items.description: More funded campaigns flowing into the ecosystem means predictable, recurring revenue for your creative work.

items.title: More Opportunities
items.description: Work with more emerging brands that have actual budgets. Access campaigns you wouldn't normally have access to.

items.title: Creative Freedom
items.description: Collaborate across multiple platforms and channels. Partner with other creators to amplify reach and create compelling campaigns.

items.title: Early Brand Access
items.description: Get in early with promising brands. Build relationships with founders and participate in their growth journey.

items.title: Trusted Partnerships
items.description: Work with brands that align with your values and audience. Your reputation stays intact while helping others grow.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple process from campaign to payment

steps.title: Browse Campaigns
steps.description: Review available brand campaigns that match your audience and expertise. Choose brands you genuinely believe in.

steps.title: Create Content
steps.description: Develop content across multiple platforms and channels. Collaborate with other creators to amplify reach and impact.

steps.title: Get Paid Directly
steps.description: Receive guaranteed payment directly from the investment pool. No chasing invoices or waiting for brand success.

credibility.title: Why Your Credibility Matters
credibility.subtitle: Content creators are valued for the conviction and trust they command

points.title: Trust Is Your Asset
points.description: Your audiences trust your judgment and recommendations. When you align with a brand vision, that trust transfers to help the founder build perception and reputation.

points.title: Multi-Platform Impact
points.description: You're not limited to promoting only on your own channel. Create content across multiple platforms, collaborate with other creators, and participate in cross-platform campaigns.

points.title: Real Brand Building
points.description: When a trusted creator with an engaged audience partners with an emerging brand, audiences begin to associate that trust with the new brand. This is how credibility transfer works.

points.title: Beyond Just Content
points.description: You're valued not for the specific platform you're on, but for the conviction and trust you command with audiences because of your established brand.
